header.tagline: I build SkyBuds: plush friends kids talk with

intro.heading: SkyBuds: talk time, not screen time

line.text: I build [SkyBuds](https://getskybuds.com): screen-free AI companion plush toys for kids ages 3 to 10.

facts.text: Just say “Hey SkyBud” and start talking: jokes, big questions and more than 75 languages.
It answers, then asks one back, and adapts its language and topics to the child’s age.
Bedtime stories made just for them, and a brushing song of its own.
No camera, no screen, no ads. kidSAFE Listed, and we don’t sell kids’ data.
